data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer whose prior startup (Alex, YC W24) was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The broader AI & Software sector includes 16 peer companies across public and private markets, though a sufficiently narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier was not available for reliable median benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $12M capital raised as a proxy for near-term value creation potential, implying a valuation of $30M. This is the primary applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Peer-median analysis was not employed; while the sector includes 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers in the broader AI & Software universe (including Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI), the narrow filters for stage-equivalence and valuation-tier proximity yielded insufficient datapoints to support a reliable median.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M–$34M, with a median of $30M. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage peer data, reliance on a single triangulation method, and the nascent nature of the company's post-seed trajectory. The founder's acquisition history and engineering pedigree support credibility but do not independently resolve valuation dispersion.
